name: kru
description: Your engineering department. Draft your team from a pool of skills and agents.

KRU_STORE_REPO.title: Store repo
KRU_STORE_REPO.description: A private git repo (owner/repo or any clone URL) that keeps the team's preferences, plans and repo notes across machines. Empty keeps them on this machine only. An exported KRU_STORE_REPO wins.

KRU_NO_LEAD_GATE.title: Skip the lead gate
KRU_NO_LEAD_GATE.description: Stop requiring the lead skill before a session's first tool call, and the startup reminder to run /kru:setup in a repo without one.

KRU_NO_GATE.title: Skip the handoff check
KRU_NO_GATE.description: Stop checking subagent briefs before dispatch.

KRU_NO_AUDIT.title: Skip the dispatch audit
KRU_NO_AUDIT.description: Stop the end-of-turn nudge to audit the session's dispatches.

KRU_NO_STORE_SYNC.title: Skip store sync
KRU_NO_STORE_SYNC.description: Keep the store repo configured but stop pulling and pushing it.
